tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Entropy characterization] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0111, page-0112 ↗ def:chow-iii-kappa-solution 1. ch19:19.32\group Entropy

For an ancient solution with $\Rm \ge 0$ and bounded curvature on each time slice, all-scale $\kappa $-noncollapsing is equivalent to a uniform bound on Perelman's entropy $\mathcal W(g,f,\tau )$ for every adjoint heat kernel. \end{claim}
